# Generated by scripts/kehillah_writing_sparks.py. Do not edit by hand.

kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = {
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_work
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_base
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_apt
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_ready_told
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_preached
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_chavrusa
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_ruled
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_answered
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_debated
}
kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = {
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_tier
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_work
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_base
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_apt
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_ready_told
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_preached
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_chavrusa
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_ruled
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_answered
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_debated
}
kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = {
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_tier
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_work
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_base
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_apt
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_ready_told
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_paths
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_did_preached
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_did_chavrusa
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_did_ruled
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_did_answered
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_did_debated
}

# Scope: a writer. FORM's slot takes a fresh Insight; WORK is its source or flag:none.
kehillah_spark_set_torah_effect = {
	kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form value = flag:torah }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_work value = $WORK$ }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_base value = kehillah_writing_parshanut_mastered_value }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_apt value = kehillah_writing_parshanut_aptitude_value }
	if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_new_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_new_parshanut_toast left_icon = this } }
}

# Scope: a writer. Offer an Insight in FORM: an empty slot takes it; a slot
# holding another form asks the player (AI keeps what it has).
kehillah_spark_offer_torah_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } }
			kehillah_spark_set_torah_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes } NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_form } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_form value = flag:torah days = 60 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_work value = $WORK$ days = 60 }
			trigger_event = { id = kehillah_spark.0002 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_work value = $WORK$ days = 60 }
			trigger_event = { id = kehillah_spark.0002 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# The player takes up the pending idea (kehillah_spark.0002).
kehillah_spark_take_pending_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:torah } kehillah_spark_set_torah_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:midrash } kehillah_spark_set_midrash_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:poetry } kehillah_spark_set_poetry_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:grammar } kehillah_spark_set_grammar_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:chronicle } kehillah_spark_set_chronicle_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:talmud } kehillah_spark_set_talmud_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:yerushalmi } kehillah_spark_set_yerushalmi_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:law } kehillah_spark_set_law_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:responsa } kehillah_spark_set_responsa_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:minhag } kehillah_spark_set_minhag_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:siddur } kehillah_spark_set_siddur_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:tradition_history } kehillah_spark_set_tradition_history_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:scriptural_law } kehillah_spark_set_scriptural_law_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:dialogue } kehillah_spark_set_dialogue_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue } kehillah_spark_set_systematic_dialogue_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:mystical } kehillah_spark_set_mystical_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:disputation } kehillah_spark_set_disputation_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:translation } kehillah_spark_set_translation_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:ethics } kehillah_spark_set_ethics_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:devotion } kehillah_spark_set_devotion_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_form
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_work
}

kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_parshanut_effect = {
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_yefet_commentary_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_yefet_commentary } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_rashi_torah_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_rashi_torah } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_chronicle_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_sefer_yosippon_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_sefer_yosippon } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_diwan_dunash_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_diwan_dunash } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_diwan_samuel_hanagid_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_diwan_samuel_hanagid } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_diwan_ibn_gabirol_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_diwan_ibn_gabirol } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_grammar_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_agron_david_al_fasi_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_agron_david_al_fasi } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_salmon_ben_jeroham_commentary_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_salmon_ben_jeroham_commentary } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_chronicle_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_cochin_copper_plates_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_cochin_copper_plates } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_ibn_ezra_torah_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_ibn_ezra_torah } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_ramban_torah_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_ramban_torah } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_sefer_hamivhar_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_sefer_hamivhar } }
}
kehillah_spark_ripen_parshanut_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_parshanut_effect = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_upgrade_parshanut_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			kehillah_spark_upgrade_parshanut_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_ready_told } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_ready_told value = yes }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_ready_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_ready_parshanut_toast left_icon = this } }
		}
	}
}
# The Upgrade button (scripted gui kehillah_spark_upgrade_parshanut).
kehillah_spark_upgrade_parshanut_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier ?= 1 kehillah_spark_can_deepen_parshanut_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = kehillah_spark.0011 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier ?= 2 kehillah_spark_can_be_great_parshanut_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = kehillah_spark.0021 }
	}
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_ready_told
	kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_parshanut_effect = yes
}

	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_ethics_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_chovot_halevavot_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_paths target = flag:work_chovot_halevavot } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_systematic_dialogue_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_kuzari_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_paths target = flag:work_kuzari } }
	if = { limit = { kehillah_spark_holds_systematic_dialogue_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_mekor_hayyim_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_paths target = flag:work_mekor_hayyim } }

kehillah_spark_ripen_hashkafa_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_upgrade_hashkafa_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			kehillah_spark_upgrade_hashkafa_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_ready_told } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_ready_told value = yes }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_ready_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_ready_hashkafa_toast left_icon = this } }
		}
	}
}
# The Upgrade button (scripted gui kehillah_spark_upgrade_hashkafa).
kehillah_spark_upgrade_hashkafa_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_hashkafa_tier ?= 1 kehillah_spark_can_deepen_hashkafa_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_tier value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = kehillah_spark.0013 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_hashkafa_tier ?= 2 kehillah_spark_can_be_great_hashkafa_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_tier value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = kehillah_spark.0023 }
	}
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_ready_told
	kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_hashkafa_effect = yes
}
kehillah_spark_ripen_all_effect = {
	kehillah_spark_ripen_parshanut_effect = yes
	kehillah_spark_ripen_talmudics_effect = yes
	kehillah_spark_ripen_hashkafa_effect = yes
}

# Scope: a writer. An action taken while holding a spark of DISC.
kehillah_spark_mark_route_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_$DISC$_form }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_$DISC$_did_$ROUTE$ value = yes }
		kehillah_spark_ripen_$DISC$_effect = yes
	}
}

		10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_mystical_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_mystical_effect = { WORK = flag:none } }
		10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_disputation_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_disputation_effect = { WORK = flag:none } }
		10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_translation_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_translation_effect = { WORK = flag:none } }
		10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_ethics_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_ethics_effect = { WORK = flag:none } }
		10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_devotion_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_devotion_effect = { WORK = flag:none } }
		1 = { }
	}
}

# Scope: the author starting a project. Uses up the chosen form's spark.
kehillah_spark_consume_current_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:torah } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:midrash } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:poetry } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:grammar } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:chronicle } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:talmud } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:yerushalmi } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:law } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:responsa } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:minhag } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:siddur } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:tradition_history } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:scriptural_law } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:dialogue } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:mystical } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:disputation } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:translation } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:ethics } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:devotion } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
}
